source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 941 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-941.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 941 was established by Ordinance No. 29710, passed by the Dallas City Council on April 22, 2015. (Ord. 29710)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-941.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 941 is established on property generally bounded Winton Street and Ellsworth Avenue, including both sides of Anita Street, west of McMillan Avenue. The size of PD 941 is approximately 7.28 acres. (Ord. 29710)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-941.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51A apply to this article. In this article:

(1) MODIFIED DUPLEX means two detached dwelling units located on one lot.

(2) TANDEM PARKING means one parking space in front of another parking space, making it necessary to pass through one parking space to gain vehicular access to the other parking space.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51A.

(c) This district is considered to be a residential zoning district. (Ord. 29710)

sections.title: Exhibit
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-941.104. EXHIBIT.

The following exhibit is incorporated into this article: Exhibit 941A: development plan. (Ord. 29710)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-941.105. DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

Except as provided in this section, development and use of the Property must comply with the attached development plan (Exhibit 941A). If there is conflict between the text of this article and the development plan, the text of this article controls. (Ord. 29710)

sections.title: Main Uses Permitted
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-941.106. MAIN USES PERMITTED.

(a) Except as provided in this section, the only main uses permitted are those main uses permitted in the D(A) Duplex District, subject to the same conditions applicable in the D(A) Duplex District, as set out in Chapter 51A. For example, a use permitted in the D(A) Duplex District only by specific use permit (SUP) is permitted in this district only by SUP; a use subject to development impact review (DIR) in the D(A) Duplex District is subject to DIR in this district, etc.

(b) The following additional main use is permitted:

-- Modified duplex. (Ord. 29710)

sections.title: Accessory Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-941.107. ACCESSORY USES.

(a) As a general rule, an accessory use is permitted in any district in which the main use is permitted. Some specific accessory uses, however, due to their unique nature, are subject to additional regulations in Section 51A-4.217. For more information regarding accessory uses, consult Section 51A- 4.217.

(b) The following accessory uses are not permitted:

-- Accessory helistop. -- Accessory medical/infectious waste incinerator. -- Accessory outside display of merchandise. -- Accessory outside sales. -- Accessory pathological waste incinerator.

(c) The following accessory use is permitted by SUP only:

-- Accessory community center (private). (Ord. 29710)

sections.title: Yard, Lot, And Space Regulations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-941.108. YARD, LOT, AND SPACE REGULATIONS.

(Note: The yard, lot, and space regulations in this section must be read together with the yard, lot, and space regulations in Division 51A-4.400. If there is a conflict between this section and Division 51A-4.400, this section controls.)

(a) In general. Except as provided in this section, the yard, lot, and space regulations for the D(A) Duplex District apply.

(b) Modified duplex.

(1) Front yard.

(A) Except as provided in this paragraph, minimum front yard is 20 feet.

(B) Minimum front yard for Lots 15, 19, 20, and 34 is 25 feet.

(C) Minimum front yard for Lots 1, 3, 16, 25, and 26 is 15 feet.

(2) Side and rear yard.

(A) Except as provided in this paragraph, minimum side yard is three feet.

(B) Minimum side yard for the easternmost lots is five feet.

(C) Minimum rear yard is 10 feet.

(D) For Lots 1 through 10, Winton Street is considered a rear yard. (Ord. 29710)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-941.109. OFF-STREET PARKING.

(a) In general. Except as provided in this section, consult the use regulations in Division 51A-4.200 for the specific off-street parking and loading requirements for each use.

(b) Modified duplex.

(1) In general. A minimum of two off-street parking spaces per dwelling unit is required.

(2) Tandem parking. Tandem parking is permitted. If tandem parking is used to satisfy the off-street parking requirements, the tandem parking must have a depth of at least 40 feet.

(3) Garage. An enclosed parking structure (garage) with two parking spaces must be at least five feet from the right-of-way line adjacent to a street or alley if an automatic garage opener is installed and maintained.

(4) Ingress and egress.

(A) Except as provided in this paragraph, ingress and egress for off-street parking must be from the public alleys.

(B) For Lots 1 through 10, 16, 25, and 26, ingress and egress for off-street parking may be from Winton Street, Anita Street, or the public alleys. (Ord. 29710)

sections.title: Environmental Performance Standards
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-941.110. ENVIRONMENTAL PERFORMANCE STANDARDS.

See Article VI. (Ord. 29710)

sections.title: Landscaping
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-941.111. LANDSCAPING.

(a) Landscaping must be provided in accordance with Article X.

(b) Plant materials must be maintained in a healthy, growing condition. (Ord. 29710)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-941.112. SIGNS.

Signs must comply with the provisions for non-business zoning districts in Article VII. (Ord. 29710)

sections.title: Additional Provisions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-941.113. ADDITIONAL PROVISIONS.

(a) The Property must be properly maintained in a state of good repair and neat appearance.

(b) Development and use of the Property must comply with all federal and state laws and regulations, and with all ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. 29710)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-941.114. COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS.

(a) All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation.

(b) The building official shall not issue a building permit to authorize work, or a certificate of occupancy to authorize the operation of a use, in this district until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. 29710)
